name: Token-dependent ChordRes with joint gate RMSNorm
tagline: One common scale for the gate’s position and velocity inputs.
description: Each sublayer uses the joint RMS of position and physical velocity to predict six controls, with three at the last MLP. Physical velocity keeps its original magnitude for the lookahead and tangent update.
mechanism: Weightless joint RMS normalization of the two inputs to each token gate
Zero-start projections preserve the initial static model
Triton fuses per-token controls into the saved-force Chord path
limitations: Research run with matched random output projections and a high Chord learning rate.

nodes: Chord read, branch and tangent write
